findings.symptom: The displayed price breakdown disagrees with its take-home amount by one cent.

evidence.source: Isolated actual editor components; pre-existing condition, not a redesign regression
evidence.summary: The fictional first print row shows $45.00 retail, $1.71 cost, $1.61 fee and $41.69 take-home; displayed subtraction gives $41.68. Other fixture variants agree. Existing calculation and rounding code is unchanged.

findings.fix: Reconcile displayed rounding or label independently rounded estimates.

findings.symptom: A titled About section still displays a generic group name without a heading.

evidence.source: Isolated actual editor components; pre-existing condition, not a redesign regression
evidence.summary: The title input contains Selected work, but the group label is STRONG section 1 with no H3 in all four tested viewport/theme combinations. This markup is unchanged.

findings.fix: Use the contextual section title as H3 with a section-number fallback.

findings.symptom: Cancelling deletion loses the keyboard user's position.

evidence.source: Isolated actual editor components; pre-existing condition, not a redesign regression
evidence.summary: All four configurations: Cancel returns activeElement to BODY after two animation frames; the recreated delete-gallery opener exists and all three placements remain. Existing handlers unchanged.

findings.fix: Restore focus to the recreated delete-gallery opener after cancellation.

findings.locator: ProductPage and BlogPostPage unsaved title inputs
findings.symptom: Refreshing silently loses unsaved product and blog title edits.

evidence.source: Isolated actual editor components; pre-existing condition, not a redesign regression
evidence.summary: All four configurations: synthetic edited names revert on reload without a beforeunload dialog or stored device draft. Gallery, Settings, Contact and About warn and restore. Existing lifecycle code unchanged.

findings.fix: Preserve device drafts or warn before leaving with unsaved work.

findings.symptom: The inherited keyboard focus indicator is difficult to see.

evidence.source: Isolated actual editor components; pre-existing condition, not a redesign regression
evidence.summary: Real keyboard focus renders a two-pixel yellow outline or inset ring with 1.203:1 contrast against the light canvas. Text contrast passes after the redesign; inherited focus styling is unchanged.

findings.fix: Use an adequately contrasting inherited neutral for document focus indicators.

findings.surface: Settings, About and Contact initial query errors
findings.locator: editorQuery data consumption and uninitialized draft branch
findings.symptom: Failed reads keep showing loading instead of explaining the error.

evidence.source: Isolated actual editor components; pre-existing condition, not a redesign regression
evidence.summary: All three synthetic read-error fixtures remain in loading. Their specific consumers wait for data without presenting query errors; Gallery, Product and Blog show errors. No production failure induced; original request-state logic unchanged.

findings.fix: Handle initial query failures separately from pending initialization and expose recovery.

rejections.observation: RV2: foreign-frame — native Settings discard confirmation
rejections.reason: All three critics rated 0: different chrome alone establishes no usability harm; confirmation is clear and dismissible. No missing taxonomy condition established.

rejections.observation: RV4: silent-stall — held synthetic loading state uses stationary status text
rejections.reason: Votes content 0, visual 1, behavior 0; mean 0.333. Visible loading text communicates the state. Missing animation alone is not a demonstrated task defect; no taxonomy gap established.

gaps.summary: Existing pointer size selection closed its listbox without changing the value, reproduced with the new stylesheet disabled. Keyboard selection works. This is a baseline interaction observation, not a layout regression; no exact named taxonomy mapping asserted.
Blog inline link Cancel left BODY focused in the synthetic fixture. Retained as supplementary baseline evidence, without generalizing from the gallery confirmation finding.
